$\Th{PA} \Proves \lforall[x][\lexists[y][(\eq[(y+y)][x] \lor
      \eq[(y+y)'][x])]]$, i.e., that every $x$ is divisible by~$2$
  (possibly with remainder~$1$). If $x$ is non-standard, so is~$y$. By
  the preceding proposition, $y 
sless y 
splus y$ and $y 
splus y
  
otin [y]$. Then also $y 
sless (y 
splus y)^
ssucc$ and $(y
  
splus y)^
ssucc 
otin [y]$. But $x = y 
splus y$ or $x = (y
  
splus y)^
ssucc$, so $y 
sless x$ and $y 
otin [x]$.
